name: io.github.JlMoreno00/sabor
title: Sabor
description: Recipes, meal plans and shopping lists with built-in SQLite or optional Mealie.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the MCP endpoint on loopback only.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Preferred response language: es or en; empty leaves it unset.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Optional TOML configuration path; non-empty environment values override file settings.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to register: core, import, shopping_sync, pricing, preferences and legacy_* sets. Empty registers discovery only; unknown names fail startup.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Recipe backend: sqlite, mealie or postgres. Unset selects mealie when MEALIE_BASE_URL is non-empty, otherwise sqlite.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection URL; required only with SABOR_STORE=postgres. Keep it in the environment or a secret store.

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Mealie adapter URL; leave unset to use built-in SQLite. Set together with MEALIE_API_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only for the optional Mealie adapter: API token sent as a bearer token; SQLite needs no token.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_LLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint for text import and portable video import, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_LLM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model name for SABOR_LLM_BASE_URL; required when that endpoint is set.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for SABOR_LLM_BASE_URL; required for non-localhost endpoints.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_VIDEO_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Video import provider: gemini_native or openai_compatible. Unset uses Gemini when GEMINI_API_KEY is set, otherwise the OpenAI-compatible LLM.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Google Gemini API key for native video recipe extraction.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bring! account email for the shopping_sync toolset; set together with BRING_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bring! account password; set together with BRING_EMAIL.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_MERCADONA_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in Mercadona pricing provider for the pricing toolset (true/false).

environmentVariables.name: MERCADONA_WAREHOUSE
environmentVariables.description: Mercadona warehouse code used for prices, e.g. mad1 or bcn1.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_OPEN_PRICES_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable read-only Open Prices crowd observations; add pricing to SABOR_TOOLSETS. Default false.
